players.product: Susquehanna nuclear + PJM baseload gas generation contracted to data centers (Amazon ~2 GW PPA, powered-land sites)

quarterly_data.signal: Talen's second-quarter 2026 earnings release reports total generation (net of station use) of 14.1 TWh in the three months ended June 30, 2026 versus 7.3 TWh a year earlier, at a capacity factor of 47.6% versus 31.8%. The release's company description states Talen owns and operates approximately 15.7 GW of power infrastructure in the United States, including 2.2 GW of nuclear power.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 generation 14.1 TWh (vs 7.3 TWh), capacity factor 47.6% (vs 31.8%); ~15.7 GW of power infrastructure incl. 2.2 GW nuclear
